sentences: Scientists measured eight features on nearly four thousand faces.
Odds of an exact match? Under one in a trillion!
Thirty-two pairs of strangers who look like twins.
All three face scanners matched sixteen pairs.
Nine pairs shared many of the same gene variants.
They even tended to share height, weight... and smoking!
With eight billion of us, it's getting more likely.
Somewhere out there... [whispers] someone has YOUR face.
